# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 1 token; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 6 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--paper, #f3f1ea);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--paper, #0f0f0e);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f3f1ea;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--paper` | #f3f1ea | #0f0f0e | Page background. The default ground for everything. |
| `--paper-raised` | #fbfaf6 | #1a1a18 | Cards, tables and panels that sit on paper. Separate with hairline, never a shadow. |

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #121212 | #f3f1ea | Primary text, wordmark, control borders, the plumb line. 16.6:1 on paper. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--chalk, #e4e0d4);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--chalk, #2a2926);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #e4e0d4;
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--chalk` | #e4e0d4 | #2a2926 | Tint fields: table headers, callouts, quiet section bands. Body text on chalk uses ink or lead only. |
| `--lead` | #5e6368 | #a3a8ad | Secondary text, captions, metadata. Named for plumbum, the lead in a plumb bob. 5.4:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on chalk. |
| `--line` | #f5431a | #ff5a2e | Signal orange, the brand color. The bob, the one thing on a page that must be seen, big numbers and fills. Not for body text on paper (3.3:1); ink text on a line fill is 5.1:1. |
| `--line-ink` | #b8330c | #ff7a55 | Orange when it has to be text: links, inline emphasis, a figure in a sentence. 4.5:1+ on paper and chalk. |
| `--plum` | #4b1d3f | #c58bb3 | Secondary brand color, the quiet nod to the name. Large fields, report covers, the editorial serif on paper. Paper text on plum is 12:1. |
| `--level` | #1b7047 | #4cc38a | Meets the standard. Pass states and grade A. Always paired with a word or glyph, never color alone. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 700 96px/0.92 "Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display); letter-spacing: -0.04em;
font-family: var(--font-serif);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 96px / 0.92, letter-spacing -0.04em | 700 | `serif` | One per page. Covers, report titles, the event stage. |
| `headline` | `.headline`, `--text-headline` | 48px / 52px, letter-spacing -0.03em | 700 | `sans` | Section openers and big claims. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 28px / 34px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 700 | `sans` | Card and playbook titles. |
| `aside` | `.aside`, `--text-aside` | 32px / 38px, italic | 400 | `serif` | The human voice: pull quotes, the turn in a headline. Never more than a line or two. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Running text. |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Captions, footnotes, metadata in lead. |
| `figure` | `.figure`, `--text-figure` | 40px / 44px, letter-spacing -0.02em | 600 | `mono` | The number that proves the claim. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 11px / 14px, letter-spacing 0.12em | 500 | `mono` | Eval IDs, tags, table headers. Set in capitals. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Geist", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `serif` | `--font-serif` | `"Instrument Serif", Georgia, serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon to label, tight inline gaps. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Label to field, chip padding. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Card padding, gaps between list rows. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Gaps between cards. |
| `--space-10` | 40px | Page margins, cover insets. |
| `--space-16` | 64px | Between page sections. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-0: 0px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-0), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-0` | 0px | Default. Blocks, cards, images, tables: Plumb is square. |
| `--radius-sm` | 4px | Inputs and buttons only. |
| `--radius-pill` | 999px | Grade chips and the Plumbed seal. |
